dialogues.speaker: Nizam
dialogues.text: Hello, I am the Vizier. Do you need any help?

dialogues.speaker: Nizam
dialogues.text: If you wished to see the Interdarshan Championship, then unfortunately, the portion taking part in Sumeru City has concluded.

dialogues.speaker: Nizam
dialogues.text: ...Hold on, on closer inspection you seem to be that guest commentator.

dialogues.speaker: Nizam
dialogues.text: My apologies. I thank you for the contributions you made to the Akademiya Extravaganza. It's all thanks to your help that the first round concluded so smoothly.

dialogues.speaker: Nizam
dialogues.text: But I might have been overindulgent in my praise. I heard the Interdarshan Championship has also encountered similar difficulties before... This time, both the contestants and viewers have been spared any harm. How fortunate.
